product_overview: TrustTasks is an adaptive daily habit app that generates three AI-powered micro-tasks each day based on a short onboarding interview and a trust-score system that adapts difficulty. The product manages user sessions, task generation/completion, a Day-0 lock/unlock flow, and a Day-8 feedback survey.
core_goals: Onboard users quickly with a short interview and persist a profile for personalization.
Generate three tailored daily micro-tasks using Google Gemini and adapt difficulty via an internal trust score.
Provide a clear daily workflow (Day 0 onboarding, daily lock/unlock, Day 8 survey) and a dashboard summarizing progress.
Allow users to manage their account (view profile, sign out, delete account) and collect feedback for model tuning.
Expose stable API endpoints for task CRUD, task generation, trust calculation, and survey submission while minimizing failure modes.

features.name: Welcome / Landing Page
features.description: Landing page checks for an existing session to decide whether to redirect the user to the dashboard or show the welcome/onboarding screen.
user_flows: GET /api/user -> Receive 200 with { user: User } (user exists) -> GET /api/dashboard with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { user, tasks, day0, locked, unlockTime, showSurvey }
GET /api/user -> Receive 200 with { user: null } -> Show welcome screen (no further API calls)
GET /api/user -> Receive 200 with { user: User } -> GET /api/dashboard with session cookie -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error (dashboard unavailable) -> Show error UI and retry option

features.name: User Onboarding Interview
features.description: Multi-step interview collects north star goal, value skill, friction trigger, and daily time window; creates or updates the user profile and sets a session cookie.
user_flows: POST /api/user with body { northStar, valueSkill, frictionTrigger, dailyWindowMinutes } -> Receive 200 with User object and session cookie set -> GET /api/dashboard with cookie -> Receive 200 with { user, tasks, day0, locked, unlockTime, showSurvey }
POST /api/user with body { northStar, valueSkill, frictionTrigger, dailyWindowMinutes } -> Receive 400 Invalid JSON body -> Show validation error to user and prevent progression
POST /api/user with body { northStar, valueSkill, frictionTrigger, dailyWindowMinutes } -> Receive 500 Failed to save configuration -> Show retry option and persist answers locally until successful

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Main dashboard displays today's three tasks, Day 0 status and locking behavior, and prompts the Day 8 survey when applicable.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { user, tasks, day0, locked, unlockTime, showSurvey } -> Render tasks and day0 flow according to response
GET /api/dashboard without session cookie -> Receive 401 No user session -> Redirect to welcome/onboarding
GET /api/dashboard with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { locked: true, unlockTime } -> Show locked state and countdown until unlockTime

features.name: Task Management
features.description: CRUD for daily tasks: fetch today's tasks, generate new tasks via Gemini, update task completion or skip status; triggers trust recalculation when daily tasks are resolved.
user_flows: GET /api/tasks with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { tasks: Task[] } -> Render today's tasks
POST /api/tasks with session cookie and user context -> Receive 200 with { tasks: Task[], header, generated: true } -> Render newly generated tasks
POST /api/tasks without session cookie -> Receive 401 No user session -> Prompt user to sign in or re-onboard
POST /api/tasks with session cookie -> Receive 500 Task generation failed (e.g. Gemini error or rate limit) -> Show generation error and queued retry option

PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with session cookie and body { completed: true } -> Receive 200 with { task: Task } -> GET /api/tasks/trust with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { its, loadMultiplier } (trust updated after all daily tasks resolved)

PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with session cookie and body { skipped: true } -> Receive 200 with { task: Task } -> If all tasks resolved trigger trust recalculation flow (GET /api/tasks/trust) -> Receive 200 with updated trust
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with session cookie and invalid body -> Receive 400 Invalid JSON body -> Show error to user and do not change task state
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} with session cookie for non-existent id -> Receive 404 Task not found -> Inform user the task no longer exists and refresh task list

features.name: Trust Score System
features.description: Expose the internal trust score (ITS) and load multiplier so the client can adapt UI and future task generation to the user's demonstrated reliability.
user_flows: GET /api/tasks/trust with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { its: number, loadMultiplier: number } -> Update UI indicators and generation parameters
GET /api/tasks/trust without session cookie -> Receive 401 No user session -> Do not display trust data and ask user to sign in
After PATCH /api/tasks/{id} marking final daily task resolved -> GET /api/tasks/trust with session cookie -> Receive 200 with updated { its, loadMultiplier } -> Persist new trust state client-side

features.name: User Profile Management
features.description: Session and account endpoints to retrieve the current profile, sign out, and delete the account and associated data.
user_flows: GET /api/user -> Receive 200 with { user: User | null } -> If user present, show account UI; if null, show sign-in/onboarding prompt
POST /api/user/signout -> Receive 200 with { success: true } -> Clear client session and redirect to welcome screen
DELETE /api/user/delete with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { success: true } -> Remove client data and redirect to signup flow
DELETE /api/user/delete without session cookie -> Receive 401 Not signed in -> Show error and prompt user to sign in before deleting

features.name: Day 8 Survey
features.description: Collect feedback on Day 8 to capture trust events and survey data used to tune task generation and trust logic.
user_flows: POST /api/survey with session cookie and body { survey_data } -> Receive 200 with { success: true } -> Show thank-you and return to dashboard
POST /api/survey without session cookie -> Receive 401 No user session -> Prompt user to sign in before submitting survey
POST /api/survey with session cookie and malformed body -> Receive 400 (invalid payload) or 500 -> Show error and preserve answers for retry

features.name: Settings Page
features.description: User settings UI that allows managing account preferences, viewing profile, signing out, and deleting the account.
user_flows: GET /api/user -> Receive 200 with { user: User } -> Populate settings UI with current profile
GET /api/user -> Receive 200 with { user: null } -> Show sign-in prompt in settings
POST /api/user/signout -> Receive 200 with { success: true } -> Clear session and return user to welcome screen
DELETE /api/user/delete with session cookie -> Receive 200 with { success: true } -> Confirm account deletion and navigate to onboarding
